description: Pick the right outdoor extension cord for camping by matching wire gauge, length and amp rating, with tables for tents, RV pedestals and generators.
directAnswer: Match the cord to the load: 16 AWG for lights and chargers, 14 AWG for up to 15 A, and 12 AWG for 10 A or more or runs near 100 feet. Look for a W-rated outdoor jacket, a grounded plug and a GFCI outlet.
